nvidia.description: NGC credentials pull gated NVIDIA images from nvcr.io. Leave the mirror empty to use the public NGC chart repositories; configure it only for a private OCI mirror. Username is conventionally “$oauthtoken”.

rancherCatalog.title: Rancher API Access
rancherCatalog.description: Credentials the operator uses to call the Rancher API. Currently this is needed only to fetch charts from git-backed ClusterRepos, which expose no HTTP or OCI URL. Those charts do not show up under Apps — the token only lets a Blueprint deploy them. Create a token in Rancher under Account & API Keys, store it in a Secret in the operator namespace, then reference that Secret below.
rancherCatalog.notAuthorized: Not authorized. The operator cannot install charts from git-backed repositories until you authorize it.
rancherCatalog.authorizedNoExpiry: Authorized. No expiry recorded for this token.
rancherCatalog.authorizeFailed: Could not create a Rancher API token: {error}
rancherCatalog.authorizeHelp: Creates a Rancher API token as your user, stores it in a Secret in the operator namespace, and saves this page.
rancherCatalog.tokenExpiring: The Rancher API token expires {expires}. Re-authorize to avoid interrupting installs from git-backed repositories.
rancherCatalog.tokenExpired: The Rancher API token expired {expires}. Charts from git-backed repositories cannot be installed until you re-authorize.

target.readOnly: Target cluster and deployment type are read-only in Manage mode.

tooltips.FleetBundle: Deploy via Fleet to any cluster (local or downstream). Bypasses chart size limits and applies changes immediately via Kubernetes API. Best for multi-cluster and large charts.
tooltips.GitOps: GitOps workflow — commits to git, Fleet auto-deploys. Best for production with version control and audit trail. Requires git repo configured. Sequential git commits, not instant.
tooltips.Helm: Direct Helm install on local cluster only. Fastest option but limited to management cluster and charts under 1 MiB. Not available for downstream clusters.
tooltips.HelmDisabled: Helm requires charts under 1 MiB (Kubernetes Secret limit) and only targets the local management cluster. Use Fleet Bundle or Fleet GitOps for large charts or downstream clusters.
